summary: Postal entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Postal 2
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows build with Paradise Lost installed

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG Windows build with Paradise Lost available
primary.why: Postal 2 is a PC-first shooter, and current Steam/GOG routes provide the practical modern Windows archive path. Paradise Lost is an official later expansion continuing the Postal 2 story and should be included for a complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build from Steam or GOG. Record storefront/build, Paradise Lost expansion state, compatibility settings, mods, mature-content settings, and whether multiplayer/community content is included.

entries.remaster_caveats: Postal 2 Redux is separate/future context and should not be merged unless it ships as a full replacement. Record mods and compatibility fixes.

entries.title: Postal
entries.definitive_edition: Current classic PC release; Postal Redux only as labeled remake comparison

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current classic PC build with content/version state documented

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG classic release with Redux documented separately
primary.why: The current classic PC release is the best route for the original 1997 isometric shooter, while Postal Redux is a separate remake with altered visuals, controls, and content. Archive the original and label Redux only as a remake comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current classic PC release from Steam/GOG or Running With Scissors. Record build, content/mature-settings state, expansion or Special Delivery/Classic and Uncut scope, difficulty, level, controls, compatibility settings, and whether Postal Redux was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Remake route with updated presentation and Rampage mode
secondary.why: It is not the original 1997 route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record content version/scope, especially Classic and Uncut versus Redux.
